Pick & Delivery Service

Delivery in Georgia

Courier services in Tbilisi Georgia is $5.00 per delivery  address.. We do delivery to every city and region of Georgia where actual address is available. Price for regional delivery is $5.00 for every 10 kg.

Pick up in USA

Gzavnili`s courier services are available in New York, New Jersey and Connecticut states. Courier service pricing and minimum requirements for pick up depends on a place from where we are going to pick up a parcel and are as follow:

  • New Jersey - Monday & Thursday
  • Staten Island - Monday & Thursday
  • Connecticut - Sunday & Wednesda
  • Bronx - Sunday & Wednesday
  • Queens - Sunday & Wednesda
  • Long Island - Sunday & Wednesday
  • Brooklyn - Daily
New Jersey 15 KG and up $10.00
Staten Island 15 KG and up $10.00
Manhattan Please call
Brooklyn 10 KG and Up 10 $
Queens & Bronx 20 KG and Up 20 $

Long island and Connecticut Customers please call to verify pick up prices

To order courier services in this three states please fill out form below and press submit button. After receiving your request we will contact you to confirm and schedule a pick up.  To schedule a pick up from other states Please go to a quotation page and fill out the form.
